claims.claim: Local before/after delta introduces no silhouette break, registration drift, spike, slab, flattening, depth inversion, or neighboring-composition damage.
Complete-view before/after delta introduces no silhouette break, registration drift, spike, slab, flattening, depth inversion, or neighboring-composition damage.
Build-report topology, orientation, and distortion evidence is compatible with retaining the repair as a candidate.
The evidence is sufficient to answer does_this_repair_delta_look_ass.

visual_evidence.source_current_order: row-major source then current for each named view

inspected_pages.observation: Registered source/current pairs with no repair-attributable gross silhouette break, spike, slab, flattening, depth inversion, or neighboring wrist/elbow damage.
Longitudinal folds, negative spaces, loop/cable, and elbow forms remain coherent; pre-existing jagged/open boundaries occur on both sides.
Circumferential silhouette, broad facets, negative spaces, and neighboring hardware remain registered without new radial deformation.
Full-arm outer silhouette, major gaps, layering, wrist termination, and elbow opening remain registered.
Bent-arm composition, wearer-facing negative spaces, long forearm members, elbow hardware, and upper-arm plate silhouette remain stable.
Oblique views preserve intentional open regions, upper-arm sweep, elbow cluster, and forearm shell without new discontinuity or depth reversal.
Circumferential silhouettes, nested gaps, broad facets, and adjacent hardware remain coherent without radial spike, slab, or flattening.

uncertainty: Source and current use different display colors, reducing sensitivity to extremely subtle shading-only differences.
Matched cameras, local and complete coverage, and axial plus oblique views are sufficient for this bounded retain/reject decision.
The repair leaves 115 component-20 cutter penetrations and 118 reserved-margin violations, so it cannot support fitted-surface promotion.

failures.reason: The environment had no usable default montage font (RenderFreetype/1665).
